policy_presence.summary: No accepted current canonical conclusion is established here; local evidence candidates and original tool records remain pending review.

ai_disclosure.summary: No universal student AI-disclosure format has been verified; follow course-specific requirements.

coursework.summary: Course AI authorization is set by the instructor; follow the syllabus for assessed work.

exams.summary: Do not assume AI is permitted in an exam; verify the instructor’s authorization for that assessment.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Sensitive or Restricted Data requires both a tool approved for that data category and a use case approved by the Data Ethics Committee.

academic_integrity.summary: Follow instructor authorization for academic work. Final-course-grade appeals and student-conduct appeals are separate procedures; do not transfer their deadlines between them.

approved_tools.summary: The Enterprise AI Toolkit distinguishes product, account, cost and data category. Confirm the complete product entry and any required use-case approval before use.

named_ai_services.summary: No accepted current canonical conclusion is established here; local evidence candidates and original tool records remain pending review.

teaching_guidance.summary: Instructors should state AI authorization and syllabus guidance for assessed and non-assessed work.

research_guidance.summary: AI outputs must be reviewed for accuracy, citation, restricted data and bias before sharing or publication.

security_procurement.summary: Unlisted AI tools require IT solutions review, and applicable use cases require Data Ethics Committee review.
